analytic_limits.geometric_p: CV^2 -> 1-p (0.98 at p=1/50, 0.967 at 1/30, 0.9875 at 1/80); median/mean -> about ln 2 = 0.693: inside both bands for every small p
analytic_limits.lognormal_cv1: CV^2 = 1; median/mean = exp(-sigma^2/2) = 2^-0.5 = 0.707: inside both bands
analytic_limits.exponential_continuous: CV^2 = 1; median/mean = ln 2: inside both bands
